title: Specimen Management Note: Add-On Retrieval Amount on Reference-Testing Cancellations
content:
Every add-on test on an Esoteric Reference Testing accession of Laboratory Test Orders means the stored specimen was retrieved. Those retrievals are added to the reference-testing cancellation handling fee.

**Clause.** When two add-on lines have been posted on the accession, whether or not either was later credited, **8.00** is added to the handling fee for the specimen retrievals already made. When one has been posted, **4.00** is added to the handling fee. An accession on which no add-on was ever posted adds no retrieval amount.

| Add-on lines ever posted on the accession (credited or not) | Added to the handling fee |
|---|---|
| Two | 8.00 |
| One | 4.00 |
| None | nothing |

**Point of judgement.** A credit does not undo a retrieval. An add-on line that was posted and later credited still counts, because the retrieval was made.
